# Coverage — NIS2 Article 21(2) risk-management measures, Article 20 governance and Article 23 reporting

**Source.** Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Articles 20, 21(2) and 23

Each NIS2 measure area is mapped to the Annex A controls that realise it at PaketPort and to the policies and procedures that document it. Coverage is reported per area with the implementation status of the mapped controls, which is what the competent authority and the management body ask for.

## Summary

| Requirements | Covered | Partial | Gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 12 | 8 | 4 | 0 |

*Covered* = every mapped control is applicable and implemented and every mapped document is approved; *partial* = at least one mapped control is partially implemented or planned, or a mapped document is still a draft or in review; *gap* = a mapped control is not applicable or not implemented, or a document is missing or retired.
